about: Components that tools/unreal-engine/python/build_player.py adds to the production player (/Game/Lunden/Player/). Other issues add their own rows here instead of opening the player Blueprints. target: character (BP_LundenPlayer) or controller (BP_LundenPlayerController); name: the component variable name, unique per target; class: a component class path (a Blueprint component ends in _C); owner: the issue that owns the row and the class; what: one line. The builder adds missing rows, removes components it added earlier whose row is gone, and leaves every other component alone. docs/development/unreal.md#player-2284

components.name: Seasons
components.what: shows seasonal pieces (actor tag seasonal: the Christmas tree) only inside their season window, from the PC's local date at game start (build_seasons.py)

components.name: Save
components.what: puts the player back at the saved place and facing at game start and saves the place every 2 s and at the end, in the user's save folder (build_save.py)
